attempts.summary: MS Computer Science student who builds cited retrieval systems: a hybrid BM25 and embedding pipeline with its own evaluation harness, and a FastAPI classification service backed by PostgreSQL.
attempts.letter_heading: Globex Data Systems — Applied AI Engineer, New Grad, Remote
cover_letter: Your team builds retrieval-augmented assistants over internal documentation and measures their quality, which is the work I have been doing in the Lakeside NLP Lab.

In the lab I built a hybrid retrieval pipeline that fuses BM25 and embedding search with reciprocal rank fusion over 4,000 forum posts, and every answer cites its source span. I also wrote the evaluation harness, 120 hand-labelled questions scored on recall@5 and citation accuracy, so each change is measured on the same set.

During my internship at Fictional Freight Co. I built a FastAPI service backed by PostgreSQL that routes support tickets into 9 queues, with pytest coverage and a CI gate. My ongoing thesis work extends this toward an agent that rejects any sentence without a retrieved citation.
I would welcome the chance to discuss how this experience fits the role.
